pages.title: Inventory Mobile Scanner
pages._note: Entry screen of the warehouse PWA: it boots the offline scanner store, shows the four operations as large touch targets and renders the sync-status badge (queued pending operations, last sync). It navigates between operations rather than presenting an object collection, so `type: index` has no register/schema to bind, and the sync badge reflects local queue state that exists only in the browser.

pages.title: Receive Goods
pages._note: Barcode-scanner receive flow (REQ-INVENTORY-001): scan, confirm SKU + quantity + location, then apply an OPTIMISTIC local update and queue a pendingOp that a background worker syncs when connectivity returns. `type: form` posts to the server on submit and reports the result; it has no offline queue, no optimistic local state and no camera scan input, so a warehouse device out of range would simply fail to save.

pages.title: Transfer Inventory
pages._note: Scanner transfer flow (REQ-INVENTORY-002): pick source location, scan, pick destination, confirm. The two InventoryStock mutations are dispatched inside ONE queued pendingOp so the server applies them atomically — a `type: form` page writes a single object per submit and would let a decrement land without its matching increment. It also shares the offline queue and camera scan input the rest of the warehouse PWA depends on.

pages.title: Pick for Order
pages._note: Scanner pick flow (REQ-INVENTORY-003): scan, reduce the quantity at the location and mark the order line picked, optionally binding the pick to an open order line so pick-to-order reconciles downstream. Two records change from one scan, through the same offline pendingOp queue as the other scanner operations; `type: form` writes one object online only and has no scan input.

pages.title: Inventory Count
pages._note: Scanner count flow (REQ-INVENTORY-004): scan or type the SKU, enter the physical count, and record the VARIANCE against the system quantity — a value computed from the live stock record at scan time and shown before the entry is queued. Reconciling that variance is deliberately a separate approval, so this page records a reference point rather than editing InventoryStock; no standard page type computes and displays a delta against a second record before submit, and none of them work offline.
